# MCPJam Inspector
\n- [MCPJam Docs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/index.md): Test, debug, and evaluate MCP servers, MCP apps, and ChatGPT apps across ever
y major AI client.\n- [Getting Started](https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md): Start testing your MCP server in minutes\n- [
Installation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md): Here's a list of all ways to start MCPJam\n- [Hosted App](https://docs.mcp
jam.com/hosted/overview.md): Use MCPJam Inspector in the browser — no installation required\n- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hos
ted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and approve the actions that spend credits\n- [
MCPJam in Claude](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/claude-connector.md): Connect Claude to your MCPJam account through the hosted MC
P server — projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing\n- [Okta SSO & SCIM](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/sso.md): Install M
CPJam from the Okta Integration Network and configure SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning\n- [IP Allowlisting](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/hosted/network.md): The addresses hosted MCPJam connects from, for firewalls and IP allowlists on your MCP and OAuth se
rvers\n- [GitHub Checks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/github-checks.md): Run an eval suite against the MCP server built from every pull
request, and read the result as a check run, a pull-request comment, and a machine-readable JSON block.\n- [Common MCP Errors](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/common-errors.md): Solutions to common MCP server connection and configuration issues\n- [Er
ror code reference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/troubleshooting/error-codes.md): What every MCPJam Inspector error code means, the lik
ely causes, and the next step to fix it.\n- [Changelog](https://docs.mcpjam.com/changelog/overview.md): Track the latest updates,
features, and improvements to MCPJam Inspector\n- [Home](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/home.md): Org-scoped dashboard with act
ivity stats, recommended servers, and quick-start clients\n- [Clients](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/clients.md): Reusable MCP
client configurations for testing servers and apps under realistic conditions\n- [Multi-server connections](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/inspector/connecting-servers.md): Connect to multiple MCP servers with different transport methods\n- [Projects](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/inspector/projects.md): Group your MCP servers into projects, with the ability to share them with your team\n- [Plugins]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/plugins.md): Import Agent Plugins 1.0 bundles as versioned, read-only projections of their skil
ls and MCP servers\n- [MCP protocol versions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/protocol-versions.md): Pin the inspector to a spec
ific MCP protocol version — including the 2026-07-28 stateless RC — to test how your server behaves across versions.\n- [Host Comp
atibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-compat.md): See which hosts your MCP server will work in — Claude, ChatGPT, Curs
or, Copilot, Codex Desktop — the moment you connect\n- [Skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/skills.md): Load and use skills
to give your agents the context they need to use MCP tools effectively\n- [Playground](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/playgroun
d.md): Chat with your MCP servers, invoke tools by hand, render widgets, and inspect every step — all in one IDE-style workspace\n
- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate
pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.\n- [Compatibility](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/compatibili
ty.md): Check whether your MCP server works on each AI host — conformance gates, per-host findings, and live widget rendering.\n-
[View origins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/view-origins.md): Which origin your MCP App's view runs at, and how to allowlist
it with a third-party API\n- [Contribute a Host](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/host-templates.md): Add a new host preset to MC
PJam so widgets can render under that host's identity, capabilities, and sandbox policy.\n- [OAuth Debugger](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/inspector/guided-oauth.md): Debug your MCP server's OAuth implementation at every step of the handshake\n- [XAA Debugger](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/xaa-debugger.md): Configure and debug Cross-App Access flows with MCPJam as the test identity provide
r and client/agent\n- [Mid-session sign-in](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/lazy-authentication.md): Test servers that let you c
onnect without signing in and ask for sign-in only when a protected call needs it\n- [MCP Inspector](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspe
ctor/tools-prompts-resources.md): Manually test your MCP server's tools, resources, and prompts\n- [Events and Triggers](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/inspector/events.md): Inspect a server's MCP Events, subscribe to them, and run an agent when they arrive\n- [Traci
ng & debugging](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/debugging.md): See all messages sent to and from your MCP server\n- [Telemetry &
privacy](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/telemetry-privacy.md): What the Inspector sends to analytics and error reporting, how
links that act as credentials are kept out of it, and how to opt out\n- [Launch from Code (Beta)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspecto
r/launch-from-code.md): Programmatically launch and configure MCPJam Inspector from your code or build tools\n- [MCP Docs Server](
https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/docs-server.md): Connect AI applications to MCPJam documentation\n- [My First MCP App](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-mcp-app.md): Build a simple Reservation MCP App from scratch\n- [My First ChatGPT App](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/guides/first-chatgpt-app-react.md): Build a simple Coffee Shop ChatGPT App with React\n- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpj
